Thoroughly Underwhelming Lazy Cafe
Aug 2024 • Solo
Having read that this was yet another of those alleged Dalat mainstays, legendary even, I walked some distance in search of the place. However, I found the whole experience very underwhelming. One has to order at the counter and pay at the start. You then wait at your table to be called to collect your drinks. Food then brought to you - otherwise, I was beginning to feel like I worked there. The restaurant is made up of many areas to choose to sit in - every table in the area I initially chose was covered in previous diners’ plates, cutlery and mess. Yet the cafe wasn't busy and staff were just hanging out. I then ate at table adorned with pot plants which had clearly been used as ashtrays as the cigarette butts were still there. When the food came - a tofu dish (limited choice for vegetarians here), it was also underwhelming. I could have made it myself. Having spent time at places in Dalat like ‘Anna’s Coffee House’, where the customer definitely comes first and the whole experience is quality, I wont bother with this place again. And its another place that only takes cash! Tiresome.
